data.exact_reserve_text: Underwriting performance has been further supplemented by favourable development from prior accident years. Due to a light incurred claims development on short tail lines the Syndicate has released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property. The Syndicate also experienced light incurred claims development and a release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business, resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss GBP 0.4m) respectively.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded favourable prior-year reserve development in 2014, driven by light incurred claims development on short-tail lines. Explicit releases were recorded in Property (GBP 2.3m), Professional Lines (GBP 3.4m) and Accident & Health (GBP 2.3m), giving a combined prior-year release of approximately GBP 8.0m (around 3.7% of opening gross claims outstanding). No specific named prior-year catastrophe events were cited as causing adverse development; the movement is attributed to generally favourable claims experience.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development from prior accident years
released reserves of GBP 2.3m (2013: GBP 4.5m) from Property
light incurred claims development on short tail lines
release of claims provision in prior years in relation to Professional Lines and Accident & Health business
resulting in favourable prior year development of GBP 3.4m (2013: GBP 5.0m) and GBP 2.3m (2013: loss GBP 0.4m) respectively
absence of catastrophe loss activity during the current accident year
reduction in the frequency and severity of risk loss activity experienced in prior years
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development is calculated by summing LOB-level releases explicitly stated in the narrative (Property GBP 2.3m, Professional Lines GBP 3.4m, Accident & Health GBP 2.3m = GBP 8.0m release). The document does not show a clearly labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross movement table on the provided pages; the reported LOB figures in the narrative were used as the primary source. It is possible the narrative figures are net of reinsurance, but the text presents them as releases of reserves by class and they have been treated as gross for this extraction. No gross claims development triangle was found in the provided pages.
